summary: reAlpha Tech Corp. filed an 8-K reporting the August 17, 2026 Amended and Restated Agreement and Plan of Merger and the August 19, 2026 closing of its acquisition of InstaMortgage Inc., a California mortgage lender. The amendment conformed deal mechanics to California law; all other material terms from the December 19, 2025 original agreement remain unchanged. Merger Sub merged into InstaMortgage, which survived as a wholly-owned reAlpha subsidiary. No price, premium, or advisor was disclosed. The substantive closing 8-K, including financials, is due within four business days.
